msg: warning: Variable pid_output is a dead store!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 8c4377dd635.c (Marlin manage_heater). Dead store on 'pid_output' from line 3 to 19, when !def(PIDTEMP). When PIDTEMP=false, pid_output=1 at line 11 is overwritten by pid_output=0 at line 19, and pid_output is never used after either assignment. Simplification artifact — real Marlin code uses pid_output to drive the heating element. Same analysis as PRODUCT_186/204. The known vbdb bug (UndeclaredIdentifier on SERIAL_ECHO_START when MARLIN_H=true && PIDTEMP=true) is not triggered here.
